description: Keeps a consumer of the VanillaBP Camunda 8 adapter inside its release line. Extend it from an application's renovate.json with "github>camunda-community-hub/vanillabp-camunda8-adapter//renovate/camunda8-lines.json".

packageRules.description: The suffix of an adapter version (2.1.0-8.9) names the Camunda 8 minor the build was compiled against, and that minor is the lowest cluster version the build accepts. Maven sorts 2.2.0-8.8 above 2.1.0-8.9, so plain maven versioning would offer an update which silently raises the cluster requirement. Regex versioning reads the suffix as a compatibility value instead, and Renovate never proposes an update that changes it: moving to another line stays a decision, taken together with the cluster upgrade.
